Ergative marking is conditioned by differential object marking. Although the standard pattern is Agent-ERG (-ʔa) and Patient-ABS (-Ø), the Patient (P) may be explicitly marked with the dative suffix -lai if it is animate, definite, or if emphasis is required to avoid ambiguity.
